capabilities: Convert a whole note to Jira markup on the clipboard
Convert a selected Markdown passage to Jira markup on the clipboard
Convert Jira markup from the clipboard back into a Markdown note
Auto-detect pasted Jira markup in Obsidian
Preview converted markup in a modal
extras: The README is mostly install instructions and a changelog; the new converter is still labeled beta in release notes while the legacy converter is being removed.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown cannot be pasted directly into Jira (or Confluence), which uses its own markup, so notes have to be reformatted by hand.

relations.evidence: Convert your note/selection into jira markup and vice versa!

summary: Format converter that turns whole notes or selections from Markdown into Jira markup on the clipboard and converts Jira markup back into Markdown notes.
